# Task lists

## Inherited markers preserve their authored scalar

```````````````````````````````` example
- [ ] open
- [x] done
- [X] also done
.
Document scope=1:1..3:15 children=1
└── List scope=1:1..3:15 flavor=bullet start=null style=null delimiter=null tight=true children=3
    ├── ListItem scope=1:1..1:10 marker=" " exampleLabel=null children=1
    │   └── Paragraph scope=1:7..1:10 children=1
    │       └── Text scope=1:7..1:10 literal="open" children=0
    ├── ListItem scope=2:1..2:10 marker="x" exampleLabel=null children=1
    │   └── Paragraph scope=2:7..2:10 children=1
    │       └── Text scope=2:7..2:10 literal="done" children=0
    └── ListItem scope=3:1..3:15 marker="X" exampleLabel=null children=1
        └── Paragraph scope=3:7..3:15 children=1
            └── Text scope=3:7..3:15 literal="also done" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## Only an initial marker is structural

```````````````````````````````` example
- a [x] b
- [x]none
.
Document scope=1:1..2:9 children=1
└── List scope=1:1..2:9 flavor=bullet start=null style=null delimiter=null tight=true children=2
    ├── ListItem scope=1:1..1:9 marker=null exampleLabel=null children=1
    │   └── Paragraph scope=1:3..1:9 children=1
    │       └── Text scope=1:3..1:9 literal="a [x] b" children=0
    └── ListItem scope=2:1..2:9 marker=null exampleLabel=null children=1
        └── Paragraph scope=2:3..2:9 children=1
            └── Text scope=2:3..2:9 literal="[x]none" children=0
````````````````````````````````
